Discussion

Speaking

Describe an advertisement or a marketing campaign that you remember well.

You should say:

  • what product or brand it was for
  • where and when you saw it
  • what made it memorable

and explain whether it changed your opinion of the brand.

Use at least two word partnerships from the unit and one personal passive (The campaign is said to…).
